sharedPrompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: final illustrated cover for a Chinese personal technical blog. Create a finished horizontal 16:9 landscape raster image, preferably 1536x864 or larger, with crisp legible Chinese text and detailed full-color 2D cel-shaded anime fan illustration. Match the user's reference design language: a large expressive anime character occupies the left 28–32% as a waist-up cutout, the right 64% contains a bold question headline plus one or two white code-window/diagram panels, pastel tinted outlines and soft offset shadows, explanatory arrows and one meaningful status icon. This is an editorial educational cover, not a mockup of a whole webpage and not a black-and-white chibi drawing. Use the named recognizable character in a natural fully clothed non-sexual pose reacting to the subject. All Chinese headline and subtitle text supplied below must be reproduced verbatim, in clean bold friendly sans-serif type, dark ink with a single accent color. Headline has strong hierarchy and fits within at most 2 lines. Keep all meaningful content at least 6% away from every edge, and particularly the top/bottom edges so blog thumbnails remain readable. Character must not overlap the headline, face and diagram cannot be cropped. Keep diagram simple with large readable labels; no tiny dense paragraph, watermark, signature, extra slogan, Japanese decoration, unrelated cat mascot, or invented performance claims. Subtle pastel-to-offwhite background, ample whitespace, balanced composition, polished educational-anime visual identity.
